question: Cultivation of cotton requires how many frost - free days?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 210.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cultivation of cotton:-**

 
 
• Cultivation of cotton is the process of growing cotton plants.
 
• Cotton is a natural fiber that is used to make a variety of products, including clothing, towels, and bedding.
 
• Cotton is a warm and durable fiber, and it is also relatively inexpensive to produce.
 
• The cultivation of cotton requires at least 210 frost-free days to grow properly.
 
 
 
• **Frost-free days:-**
 
 
• These are the number of days in a year where the temperature **does not fall below 32°F or 0°C.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **140** is the number of frost-free days required for **potato cultivation.**
 
• **160 **is the number of frost-free days required for **maize cultivation.**
 
• **250** is the number of frost-free days required for **rice cultivation. **
